name: Baked Apple
description:
An apple is cored, filled with a little honey and baked until the skin wrinkles. The warm fruit is served with the syrup collected beneath it.

Sold as one individual dessert portion. Price and weight cover the named food only; plates, bowls and cutlery remain with the inn. Drinks and unlisted sides are separate. This meal grants no automatic healing or resting bonus.
